effect_description_eng:
[Security] At the end of the battle, if you don't have Digimon, play this card without paying the cost.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, you may unsuspend this Digimon.
